name: iPSC tri-culture to capsule-based single-cell RNA library: Encapsulation, emulsion break, capsule wash and curing chip
source: Grow three iPSC-derived cell types (neurons, microglia, astrocytes) side by...
description: Generated by autochip from protocol IR 'ipsc_triculture_single_cell_capsule_rnaseq' for chip chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing (Merges cells into core solution, makes single-cell shell/core droplets in fluorinated oil, then breaks the emulsion, washes, cures and washes the capsules in a trap.). Flows, volumes and times the source did not give are placeholders.

steps.note: IR step 9 (encap_junction): encapsulate: FEED inlet_1 (cells_suspension) at 1 uL/min, core_solution_in (core_solution) at 1 uL/min, shell_polymer_in (shell_polymer) at 2 uL/min, fluorinated_oil_in (fluorinated_oil) at 10 uL/min, VENT capsule_trap_waste_out, all else capped. Wrap single cells in droplets of shell polymer around an aqueous core, formed in fluorinated oil at a chip junction.

IR step 10 (capsule_trap): exchange to emulsion_breaker: FEED emulsion_breaker_in (emulsion_breaker) at 5 uL/min, VENT capsule_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash (default flow). Break the emulsion with an emulsion-breaking agent and remove the oil phase.

IR step 11 (capsule_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED wash_buffer_in (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT capsule_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 3 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules to remove leftover oil.
IR step 12 (capsule_trap): cure under 405 nm light for 1 min, all ports capped. Cure the capsule shells with light.

IR step 13 (capsule_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED wash_buffer_in (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT capsule_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 2 washes (default flow). Wash the cured capsules.

IR step 13 (capsule_trap): collect the capsules: FEED wash_buffer_in (buffer push), VENT outlet_1 into a tube labelled 'chip2_encapsulation_emulsion_break_capsule_wash_curing: capsules after step 13, for chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release inlet_1'. Every other port capped.
